note: u8=255*(q-lo)/(hi-lo); rho: log10 mass/voxel (1e10 Msun/h) after 1-voxel gaussian, 384 grid; temp: mass-weighted log10 T[K]; xray: log10 sum m*rho*sqrt(T) (T>1e6K); slum: log10 r-band L/voxel (mag zero point), 384 grid; scol: L-weighted g-r; dm: log10 DM mass/voxel after 1-voxel gaussian, 384 grid; mach: max Mach in voxel; ed: log10 sum EnergyDissipation, 384 grid. 192 grids shift extensive quantities by log10(8).
